question: Private package registry choice. Priorities: permission model clarity and fewer surprise proxy failures. Write a short research-style recommendation memo from the retrieved sources only. Candidates: GitHub Packages, PyPI, Cloudsmith, GitLab Package Registry, npmjs, Google Artifact Registry, Sonatype Nexus, Azure Artifacts, AWS CodeArtifact, JFrog Artifactory. End with a numbered list of all ten from best to worst.

web_snippets.excerpt: JFrog Artifactory permission model matched how the org already thinks about teams.
Sonatype Nexus is flexible and easy to misconfigure.
Teams adopt GitHub Packages quickly, then invent scripts around auth edge cases.
AWS CodeArtifact OSS proxy outage rate was the lowest in a six-month ops note.
npmjs is simple until you need fine-grained tokens.

notes: Contested evidence: two competitors look stronger on stated priorities; principal only in mixed tradeoff notes. No answer-key ranking.
